fidelity_notes: Almighty and everlasting renders Omnipotens sempiterne; wondrous in the ordering of all your works renders the full relative clause without importing the older word order as a theological difference.
May those you have redeemed understand renders intelligant redempti tui.
The making of the world in the beginning / sacrifice of Christ our Passover at the end of the ages preserves the two compared quod clauses and non fuisse excellentius.
The separately witnessed complete short ending has Christ as antecedent. The distinct R. Amen. is preserved as a response, not folded into the prayer petition.
